params.prompt: Photorealistic architectural photograph, same contemporary house throughout: raw light-grey board-formed concrete, brushed brass doors, frames and volumes, dark olive upholstery, warm natural daylight, eye-level camera at 1.5 m, 24 mm lens, perfectly straight vertical lines, calm editorial photography, no people, no text, 16:9. The camera approaches the floor-to-ceiling sliding glass window of the bedroom, standing 1.5 meters from it: the glass panel is partly slid open, the terrace with tall trees is visible beyond, brass window frame at the side, the bed at the left edge of the frame.
